# Coding AI Prompt — Cora-Style Landing Page

## 1. Strict Architectural Rules

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- Keep all styling strictly inside `style.css`. Forbid the `style="..."` attribute in HTML.
- Target all design properties, layout rules, and states via class or ID selectors only.
- Keep HTML clean, semantic, and agnostic of visual styling so the look can change by editing CSS alone.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
Store all visual tokens in `:root` (and theme classes) using CSS variables. Define at minimum:
- Colors: `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`.
- Cora palette tokens: `--color-cerulean-sky: #117bc8`, `--color-deep-cerulean: #0d5c96`, `--color-atmosphere-blue: #60a8dd`, `--color-midnight-navy: #09426c`, `--color-berry-red: #cf372d`, `--color-cloud-white: #fefefe`, `--color-mist-gray: #ebebeb`, `--color-fog: #dadada`, `--color-stone: #a1a1a1`, `--color-graphite: #7d7d7d`, `--color-ink: #2b2b2b`, `--color-obsidian: #1d1b20`.
- Light background must not be pure white; use `#fefefe` where a near-white is needed (Cloud White).
- Contrast pairing: every light background token pairs with a dark text token and vice versa for every theme.
- Border radius & shadows: `--radius-sm`, `--radius-md`, `--radius-lg`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`.
- Spacing & transitions: `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`.
- Elevation/stacking: `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
- Provide dark mode color tokens under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and/or a `.dark` class selector.
- Background and text CSS variables must switch seamlessly without HTML restructuring.
- Persist user theme choice via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit; include a visible toggle control with correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label` state.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- Build all layout structures with Flexbox (`display: flex`).
- Every flex container must default to `align-items: center` unless an explicitly justified exception exists.
- All flex layouts must be mobile-responsive out of the box (rows convert to columns on small viewports). Prevent horizontal scrolling.

**1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration**
- Use Tailwind CSS (or clean custom CSS driven by Tailwind's `@layer` / `@apply`) unless another framework is requested. All utility classes must map back to CSS variables or generic reusable class names (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- Strictly use Google Fonts for text and icons. Include Google Font `<link>`/`@import` tags and bind to `--font-base`.
- Text fonts: load "Cormorant Garamond" (substitute for signifier) weights 300, 400 and "Inter" (substitute for switzer) weights 400, 500, 600, 700. Bind serif to `--font-signifier` and sans to `--font-switzer`.
- Icons: use Google Material Symbols/Icons. Forbid raw inline SVGs or local icon files.

## 2. Component Design Specifications

**2.1 Button Component**
- Default: Flex layout (`display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;`). Minimum touch target 44x44px.
- Hover: visual shift (brightness/shadow) with `cursor: pointer`.
- Focus: distinct focus ring using CSS variables.
- Active/Pressed: `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- Loading: disables interactions, prevents double-clicks, renders CSS spinner or animated Google Icon without distorting dimensions.
- Disabled: `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- Success/Error: temporary feedback styles driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error`.
- Pill radius `9999px` for all buttons and tags. Primary filled action background `#09426c` (Midnight Navy), text white, switzer 16px weight 500, padding 12px 24px, trailing arrow icon. Secondary outlined action: transparent/white bg, 1px border `#60a8dd`, text `#60a8dd`, same padding.

**2.2 Card Component**
- Default: flexible Flexbox layout, subtle borders and elevation using `--bg-secondary` and CSS variables.
- Hover: elevation/shadow shift or `transform: translateY(-2px)`.
- Focus-within: highlight card borders when a child link/button receives focus.
- Loading (Skeleton): shimmer animation in CSS to prevent layout jumps.
- Empty State: structured fallback with Google Icon and clear guidance text.
- Testimonial card: white bg, 12px radius, 24px padding, shadow `0px 4px 4px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)`. Quote switzer 16px weight 400 `#2b2b2b`. Attribution: name switzer 14px weight 600 `#2b2b2b`, role switzer 14px weight 400 `#a1a1a1`. Optional avatar circle. 24px gap between cards.

**2.3 Form & Input**
- States: Empty, Focused (outline ring), Filled, Valid (success border/icon), Invalid (error border, red text, error icon), Disabled, Read-only.
- Structure: Flex container wrapping label, input field, and dedicated error feedback container.

**2.4 Modal / Popup**
- States: Opening, Open, Loading, Success/Error, Closing (all animated via CSS transitions).
- UX: centered flex container (`align-items: center`), backdrop overlay, Google Icon close button, keyboard focus trapping, close via Esc or overlay clicks.

## 3. Core UX & Micro-Interaction Rules
- Responsive by default: fluid sizing, responsive breakpoints, no horizontal overflow.
- Smooth animations: CSS transitions on all state changes (`transition: var(--transition-normal)`), respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Accessibility: sufficient contrast in both Light and Dark modes; never rely solely on color for state; semantic HTML5; correct ARIA roles/labels; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability; `aria-live` regions for dynamic feedback.
- Mandatory visual feedback on every click, hover, or submission.
- Destructive actions visually distinct in both themes.

## 4. Deliverables & Output Format
- Separate `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No inline `<script>` beyond a single deferred entry-point reference.
- Enforce one consistent class-naming convention (BEM) across the entire deliverable — never mix conventions.
- No lorem-ipsum-only submissions where real copy/labels are supplied; placeholders allowed only where content genuinely unspecified.
- File structure and naming in English/ASCII.

## 5. Edit Mode
Not applicable — this is a from-scratch build.

## 6. Theme-Specific Instructions (Cora Style)

**Brand Fiction (mandatory):** Invent a fictional brand name, product, and copy. Never use the real brand name "Cora", its logo, trademarks, or product names anywhere in the page. Do not reference the source painting, artist, or brand. All user-facing copy must be in English.

**Visual Language:**
- Full-bleed atmospheric illustration as the page canvas (sky painting with clouds, tree foliage, birds) at 100vw × 100vh for hero and transition sections — never crop to a banner or place in a card. Use a CSS background image placeholder (a gradient stand-in is acceptable only as a clearly-marked placeholder comment; prefer a real image URL slot). No gradient overlay on the illustration.
- Alternate full-bleed sky sections with white content sections. Rhythm: sky hero → white testimonials → sky section → white content → sky CTA.
- Typography: serif (Cormorant Garamond substitute) weight 300 at 45–55px for hero/section titles, weight 400 at 24–36px for subheadings; sans (Inter substitute) for all UI/body at 14–18px. Never set UI text in serif or headlines in bold sans.
- Shadows tinted with brand blue `#0d5c96` at 0.25 opacity or `rgba(0,0,0,0.1)` — no neutral gray shadows.
- All borders either `#dadada` (hairline on white) or `#60a8dd` (on sky). No neutral gray borders.
- Palette disciplined: white, cerulean, midnight navy, atmosphere blue, one red accent (`#cf372d` used sparingly). No additional chromatic UI colors.
- Body text 14–18px only.

**Sections to build (in order):** Hero, Features (3 cards), How It Works (3 steps), Testimonials, Pricing (3 tiers), FAQ, Final CTA, Footer with secondary links.

**Hero:** 100vh sky canvas, centered white serif headline at 55px weight 300, white subtext at 18px switzer weight 400 at 80% opacity, single primary filled action (Midnight Navy pill) with trailing arrow. Transparent top nav: logo left in a small bordered badge, "Log in" text link, "Start free trial" cerulean pill. Product UI preview frame (laptop mockup ~70% width) centered below headline.

**Features:** 3 cards on white section, 12px radius, 24px padding, elevation shadow. Each with icon (Material Symbols), title, description.

**How It Works:** 3 steps on sky section, white serif headline 45px weight 300, numbered steps with white text.

**Testimonials:** horizontal row of 3 testimonial cards on white section, 24px gap.

**Pricing:** 3 tiers on white section, cards with tier name, price, feature list, CTA button. Middle tier highlighted.

**FAQ:** accordion on white section, chevron icons, expand/collapse via CSS transitions, keyboard accessible.

**Final CTA:** sky section with centered serif headline and primary filled action, no panel behind text.

**Footer:** white section with secondary links, logo badge, copyright.

**Accessibility & Motion:** respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; full keyboard operability; `aria-live` for dynamic feedback; focus rings on all interactive elements.

**Output only the finished prompt.** No preamble, no closing commentary. Mirror the numbered-header structure above. If any request conflicts with a mandatory rule, keep the mandatory rule and add a one-line explicit exception clause.
